title: Sanctus (Lassus, Missa Doulce memoire)
desc: Orlande de Lassus, Missa Doulce memoire, Sanctus, c. 1568-1569. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0033_4); edited by Franz Körndle, Vincent Besson. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
